title: Boku no Hero Academia: Memories
content:
I was hesitant at first that these episode would be about some random fun at your first stop beach, you know, the usual fan service setup, but no, it turned out to be a four-episodes-long recap of the entire series leading up to the 7th season, and before you start freaking out, this was actually a recap done right.

Recaps themselves are pretty tricky and controversial, there is always something wrong with them. Sometimes it’s the boring content being retold while skipping on all the high-key moments, some other times it’s just a compilation of cool moments with cheesy character voice overs on top (I personallyhate those). This one however nail all the big points I could think of. It’s still a recap release at the end of the day, and in my case, having watched it after a very prolonged hiatus after season 6 really worked well for me. Too well in fact.

All four episodes cover one to two character arcs in them, never more. They cover conflicts, resolve and resolution of a select characters from their introduction in season 1 till the point of the story where season 6 left. My favorite thing about this was that each episode had and openings and ending from throughout the seasons up until that point. So a nostalgia trip from the first minute.

Overall: 7.32/10.
